The quoted sending-to-kill clause is present in the already listed 111/101. Verse 77/23 instead has mšaylallux (“I would like to ask you something”), a different verb and context. The automatic candidate 77/180 is also unrelated and must not replace it. Retain 493 and 111/101; remove the spurious additional reference.
